target.title: fix(agents): merge runtimeToolAllowlist into pluginToolAllowlist for embedded runs
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #100537 — When `active-memory` is configured with `toolsAllow` pointing to external plugin tools (like `lcm_grep`, `lcm_describe`, `lcm_expand_query` from `lossless-claw`), the embedded sub-agent run fails with:

```
No callable tools remain after resolving explicit tool allowlist
(runtime toolsAllow: lcm_grep, lcm_describe, lcm_expand_query);
no registered tools matched.
```

The main runtime can see these tools via `openclaw plugins inspect`, but the embedded recall sub-agent cannot resolve them.

## Why This Change Was Made

**Root cause**: In `createOpenClawCodingTools` (`src/agents/agent-tools.ts:881`), the `pluginToolAllowlist` used for plugin tool resolution was derived solely from `capabilityProfile.policy.explicitToolAllowlist`, which is collected from layered tool policies. In embedded sub-agent runs, the capability profile's explicit allowlist may not fully carry the runtime `toolsAllow` entries due to policy layering interactions.

**Fix**: Merge `options.runtimeToolAllowlist` (the direct runtime tool allowlist) into `pluginToolAllowlist` before passing it to `resolveOpenClawPluginToolsForOptions` → `resolvePluginTools`. This ensures the exact tool names requested by the embedded run caller are always present for plugin tool resolution.

## User Impact

- Active-memory with external plugin `toolsAllow` (e.g. `lcm_*` tools from lossless-claw) can now resolve plugin tools in embedded recall runs
- No behavior change for existing `memory_search`/`memory_get` (default) and `memory_recall` (LanceDB) paths
- No behavior change for normal (non-embedded) agent runs
- Backward compatible

## Evidence

| Test suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `attempt-tool-construction-plan.test.ts` | 23/23 passed (2 new tests added) |
| `agent-tools.create-openclaw-coding-tools.test.ts` | 136/136 passed |
| `active-memory/index.test.ts` | 156/156 passed |

- `git diff --check` passed
- `oxfmt --check` passed

## Files Changed

- [`src/agents/agent-tools.ts`](src/agents/agent-tools.ts) — Merge `runtimeToolAllowlist` into `pluginToolAllowlist` at the plugin tool resolution boundary
- [`src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt-tool-construction-plan.test.ts`](src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt-tool-construction-plan.test.ts) — Add tests for external plugin tool names (e.g. `lcm_*`) and unknown tool names in construction plan
